item_short_desc: Rothco’s Canvas Medic Bag is designed to simplify carrying everyday essentials. Its large main compartment, measuring 12.5 inches X 11 inches X 3.5 inches, accommodates notebooks, mobile devices, and other supplies. The front flap closure, secured with leather straps, ensures the safety of your gear. Crafted from sturdy 22oz. unwashed canvas, this bag is built to withstand daily use. The fully adjustable shoulder strap allows for comfortable crossbody or over-the-shoulder carry.
